instructions.name: claim
docs: Claims tokens from a specified bucket after lottery finalization.
`bucket` specifies which allocation to claim: `Sale` for lottery winners
or `Team` for team allocation. Requires claims to be open.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit lamports (must be multiple of τ); allocate tickets in bitmap; move lamports to escrow.

instructions.name: finalize_lottery
docs: Finalize lottery - select winners and open claims

instructions.name: refund
docs: Refunds SOL to participants for non-winning lottery tickets.
Requires lottery to be finalized and claims to be open.

instructions.name: set_seed
docs: Permissionless seed setter using recent blockhash.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw during funding window (reduces ticket_count and returns lamports).

errors.name: BadAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be multiple of tau

errors.name: InvalidDivisor
errors.msg: Divisor must be greater than zero

errors.name: NoRecentBlockhashes
errors.msg: No recent blockhashes found in SlotHashes sysvar

errors.name: NoValidBlockhash
errors.msg: No valid blockhash found in recent blocks

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Invalid price: must be finite and positive

types.name: AmmConfig
docs: Holds the current owner of the factory

fields.name: trade_fee_rate
docs: The trade fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: fund_fee_rate
docs: The fund fee, denominated in hundredths of a bip (10^-6)

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the launch was created
